checks.name: identity-action
checks.command: cargo test --locked --manifest-path truelearner/Cargo.toml -p truelearner-embodiment --test perception_action absent_command_is_the_identity_action

findings: The shared interaction cycle has one explicit order: sense the physical state, ask an outside chooser for an optional command, apply an available command once, and sense the resulting state again.
The identity case returns no effect, never invokes the actuator, and preserves the physical state. An available command invokes act exactly once.
A request of five at position nine with a limit of ten returned actual movement one and an after-reading of ten, proving the return is based on post-action state rather than copied from the request.

The same cycle composed two visual channels with one unavailable eye, five independently constrained fingers, repeated orientation until identity, and a held-out body containing two visual readings, one contact reading, and three actuator ports.
The chooser remains outside the library and may capture explicit physical action context. The library contains no target, object identity, coordinate, score, desired direction, or learner state.
BoundedAxis now uses the shared cycle for its real position update and proprioceptive after-reading while preserving exact clamping, origin, incidence, and actual-effect behavior.

Stable fixation remained byte-identical at SHA-256 4da905f0907302d16b1462f409769c6ebe27e11b474bc45499549a3fdd894b20, and the Production visual-reach trace remained byte-identical at SHA-256 4be6c6f75aefe9dc2f38d019ce0f4f9133b26d650e0016a5b5b051f40241b2af.
Formatting, all-target compilation, strict lint, semantic firewall, and the representative warm regression passed; the independent warm run completed in 0.52 seconds.
residual_uncertainty: This is neutral infrastructure. It does not prove that the organism chooses an action-relevant visual signal, groups views into objects, carries identity through occlusion, estimates depth, reaches, or learns contact.
The chooser is deliberately supplied by the caller. Whether the current learner and physical action context are sufficient to produce purposeful selection remains an experimental question.
The cycle is synchronous. Real sensors with independent delays require explicit physical-time adapters and stale-data controls before reuse.

The live workstation retains its established across-step return timing; only the neutral BoundedAxis driver was migrated to the new cycle. End-to-end migration should occur only when a capability experiment needs it and can preserve traces.
